what_it_is.prose: No. 3 Base Repair Depot (3 BRD) is an Indian Air Force overhaul depot at Chandigarh, established on 20 August 1962 under Maintenance Command. Per the IAF's official listing, it specialises in Russian-collaboration overhaul, having handled the IL-14 transport and Mi-4 helicopter historically and, more recently, the overhaul of Mi-8 and Mi-17 helicopters and upgrades for the Mi-25, Mi-26 and Mi-35 families. This is a compact (Tier C) card: beyond the official unit listing and general press recognition, there is limited public, India-specific technical or programme detail to support a fuller dossier. The card is preserved for register completeness and can be elevated if primary-source evidence (MoD/IAF releases, contract details) becomes available.

open_questions: Public detail on No.3 BRD's current workload, capacity and any fixed-wing transport overhaul role is limited.
Whether the depot has a role in An-32 or Il-76 fixed-wing overhaul is not established in sources reviewed (its documented focus is Russian helicopters/transport).
